issues.note: R002: E003 requires a=t_n>=0, but its statement and source contract do not define t_n, quantify its index or establish any admissible nonnegative grid base for each positive tau. None of the supplied definitions provides this information. R002/S003 consequently cannot specialize E003 at t_0=0 for either endpoint estimate or the rough-input extension. The multiplier conjugation identity transfers a bound from an already admissible source base; it proves neither existence of such a base nor t_0=0. Completing the supplied proof route requires a source-grounded completion of E003 and its grid definitions establishing an admissible base for each tau (in particular t_0=0 for the present proof). That changes a shared definition or public input and cannot be introduced as an R-local premise. The repaired loss choice, product estimate and scalar exponent calculations do not discharge this distinct grid condition.
